Database.//: Provider can be 'Sqlite' (default, zero-setup demo) or 'SqlServer' (Azure SQL).

ConnectionStrings.//: For Azure SQL set Provider to SqlServer and put the Azure SQL connection string here.

Email.//SupplierAddress: Your INTERNAL TEAM inbox — new client enquiries are emailed here.
Email.//Provider: 'Brevo', 'Smtp', 'SendGrid', or 'Outbox'. Blank = auto (Brevo > SMTP > SendGrid > dev outbox).
Email.//Brevo: Recommended. Set BrevoApiKey via user-secrets. Needs a verified sender in Brevo (no SMTP details required).
Email.//SendGrid: Set SendGridApiKey via user-secrets / Azure config to use SendGrid.
Email.//Smtp: Set these (ideally via user-secrets) to send through any SMTP provider — your domain mailbox host, Brevo, etc.
